auth.passwordSaved: Password saved. Sign in with your new password.
auth.accessChanged: Your access has changed. Please sign in again.

twoFactor.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
twoFactor.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone, or use a backup code.

profile.languageMoreComingSoon: More languages will appear here once the clinic enables them.

membership.howToCancel: Cancel any time from Profile > Membership. You keep access until the end of the period you've paid for.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.requiredForRole: Required for your role — a code from your authenticator app, every time you sign in.
twoFactor.optional: Optional — adds a second step to sign in, using an authenticator app.
twoFactor.setupToContinue: Set this up to continue to your dashboard.
twoFactor.on: Two-factor authentication is on. {count, plural, one {# backup code left.} other {# backup codes left.}}
twoFactor.scanInstructions: Scan this with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or similar), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
twoFactor.saveBackupCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe.
twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Each works once, if you ever lose access to your authenticator app. This is the only time they're shown — write them down now.
twoFactor.enterPasswordToTurnOff: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.

resetByEmail.title: Two-factor reset
resetByEmail.description: Required for clinic owners and platform admins — if someone loses their authenticator, this clears it so they can set it up again. Every reset is written to the audit log against their account.
resetByEmail.confirmed: Two-factor authentication was reset for {email}. They'll be asked to set it up again next time they sign in.
